correctness.rationale: With j denoting zeros, the forbidden word has length j+2, so the length-(N+1) cover permits every j≥N and keeps the original indicator below N. The renewal root equation gives entropy; the root discrepancy at h is exactly r^(N+1) times the bounded complemented tail. The derivative differs from -T by O_alpha(Nr^N), the second derivatives are bounded near h>0, and the root approaches h from above. The mean-value estimate followed by Taylor gives the stated rescaled error. The phase digit sum is a weighted cumulative sum of distinct dense jumps at {-n alpha}. The jump sizes sum to the endpoint span, so there is exactly one gap of each reported size and no others. Density of the positive orbit, also after deleting any finite prefix, recovers both one-sided phase limits, and strict increase gives no isolated image values in the closure. The m+1 prefixes of length m and exponentially bounded tails prove dimension zero. At a missing gap stage the periodic witness is legal before the added ban and illegal after; equivalently the single removal strictly decreases the renewal series at the previous root. This proves strict entropy decrease without a presentation assumption. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed, and its finite diagnostics are not the proof.
residual_risks: The root estimate is for each fixed irrational alpha and does not assert slope-uniform constants.

evidence: On [0,1) the n-th floor term of the prior lift jumps once at {n*rho}, by (1-r)r^(n-1), and these locations are distinct and dense. The endpoint span is one. The tail after the first m terms has uniform oscillation at most r^m, so each of at most m+1 pieces of the m-term partial sum gives a covering interval of diameter at most r^m. Dense positive jumps leave both endpoints of every gap nonisolated.

The cutoff removes only distance L, so the plateau iff a_L=1 and strict renewal-root drop otherwise are independent of the word. The orbit of {N alpha} is dense and yields the two one-sided limits, with no additional limit points.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Taking jumps of the published floor series directly yields the exact census, span and dimension; the entropy approximation only prescribes the base and rescales that known formula. The remainder and plateau do not supply a separate result beyond the cutoff renewal argument. There is no unsupported claim here of an earlier verbatim entropic formulation.

evidence: Laurent–Nogueira, §5.1, give phi(t)=delta/(1-r)+(1-r) sum_{n>=1} r^(n-1) floor(t-n*rho) and phi(0)=0 for irrational rho. Their limit set is the range on [0,1), with the closure giving the Cantor set.

The frozen digit map satisfies G(theta)=(1-r) sum_{n>=1} r^(n-1) floor(theta+n*alpha) on [0,1). At rho=1-alpha, floor(theta-n*rho)=floor(theta+n*alpha)-n. The change is a constant, fixed by phi(0)=0, so phi(theta)=G(theta)-G(0).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The attractor is not merely analogous. The cluster set is exactly A-T^(-1) times that range closure, with A=((1-r)^(-1)-G(0))/T (that is, the image under x ↦ A-x/T). The reflected and rescaled gap lengths are direct properties of the same floor series.

originality.rationale: The apparent distinguishing result, the complete geometric Cantor gap census, is mechanically obtained from a previously published identical phase function. Laurent–Nogueira's irrational contracted-rotation lift in §5.1 equals G(theta)-G(0) after substituting their contraction parameter r and their rotation number 1-alpha. Its floor terms have one jump each of precisely the requisite geometric size; the normalized entropy spectrum is just its closed range reflected, translated and scaled. The cutoff renewal calculation that gives this affine substitution is the same general bounded-tail Taylor calculation already used in the geometric-gap and Thue–Morse analogues, and the plateau rule is the generic cutoff rule. This is verified implication for the distinctive geometry, not an assertion that an earlier paper stated the Sturmian entropy theorem verbatim, and not a verdict based on a missing text or inferred same-day precedence.
residual_risks: No exhaustive priority claim is made about the specific entropy-language interpretation. Laurent–Nogueira's 2021 Hecke–Mahler paper was identified by reference, not relied on for the implication; the 2018 full-text series suffices.

value.rationale: This is a correct illustration of a contracted-rotation Cantor set arising in entropy approximation, but the narrow exact invariant does not survive as a substantive standalone result under the review standard. The number and sizes of the gaps are just the jump weights of the identical prior phase map with an explicit affine change of units. The remaining entropy-tail and plateau calculations use only the standard gap cutoff and root perturbation, not a new restriction, invariant, or estimate that distinguishes this indicator. Narrowing the finding to those calculations would not repair this issue.
residual_risks: The connection can be useful exposition; the decision is about the standalone claimed exact result, not the usefulness of entropy asymptotics generally.
